license_note: The model card declares a modified MIT license and links to the LICENSE file in the MiniMax-M2 GitHub repository; the Hugging Face weight repository carries no license file of its own. That document reproduces the MIT grant but requires commercial products above 100 million monthly active users or 30 million US dollars in annual recurring revenue to prominently display 'MiniMax M2', so the release is source-available rather than open source.

license_evidence.scope: MiniMax-M2 model weights, repository code, and derivative works, as linked from the Hugging Face model card

access_boundary: This record represents the MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M2 repository release at commit 757303d492a50514c312788b5247a4f696a4c6a3 (last modified 2025-12-23). MiniMax-M2.1 and later M2.x releases, the MiniMax Agent product, the MiniMax Open Platform API, and downstream quantizations remain separate boundaries.
strengths: MiniMax publishes Safetensors shards with in-repository deployment guides for vLLM, SGLang, Transformers, and MLX
The MiniMax Open Platform documentation lists MiniMax-M2 as a served model alongside its successors
tradeoffs: The governing license lives in a separate GitHub repository rather than alongside the weights, and its attribution threshold makes the release source-available
The model card carries no release date, and the platform documentation labels the model historical without a stated retirement date

evidence.label: Official model card, checkpoint, and in-repository deployment guides
